main.summary: Writable cursor over a fixed serialization buffer.
main.remarks: This ref struct writes primitive values and byte ranges into a caller-owned .

property.name: Length
property.summary: Total writable length of the backing span.

property.name: WrittenSpan
property.summary: Written region of the backing span.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a writable cursor over a destination span.

method.name: TryWriteByte
method.summary: Write a single byte into the destination span.
method.returns: True when the value was written; otherwise false.

method.name: TryWriteBytes
method.summary: Write a sequence of bytes into the destination span.
